result.summary: The page is largely intact with no critical breakage, but found 2 minor visual issues: empty profile avatar and inconsistent wishlist icon styling.

issues.description: Top-right profile/avatar area appears as an empty light-grey circle with only a small red dot, looking like a failed image load or missing placeholder.
issues.suggestion: Load the user avatar or show a proper placeholder with user initial/icon, keeping the notification badge clearly visible

issues.description: Wishlist heart icons in 'Popular right now' have inconsistent styling: Tokumaru Ramen Bar heart has no background while the pizza card below shows a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent heart button style with sufficient contrast background across all restaurant cards
